chunks.transcript_title: The Ultimate Guide to Product-Led Growth (PLG) and Product-Led Sales
chunks.excerpt: Third, and my personal favorite for modern B2B, is the Reverse Trial. You give the user full enterprise access for 14 days without requiring a credit card. At the end of 14 days, instead of kicking them out of the product, you gracefully downgrade them to a permanently free tier. This builds product habit while demonstrating the power of paid enterprise features.

response.text: According to Elena Verna on Lenny's Podcast (Episode 78), a Reverse Trial is a hybrid model where users receive full enterprise access for 14 days without a credit card. At the end of the 14 days, rather than locking them out, you gracefully downgrade them to a permanently free tier.
